question: What is the name of the new one-stop digital platform being launched by the Election Commission of India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**ECINET**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ECI to soon launch single-point app ECINET for all electoral-related activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Election Commission of India** is launching a **unified digital platform** named **ECINET**.

 
 
• 
 
ECINET will **integrate over 40** existing mobile and web apps of the EC into **one single interface**.

 
 
• 
 
The platform is aimed at **electors**, **election officials**, **political parties**, and **civil society**.

 
 
• 
 
It features an **aesthetic UI** and **simplified UX**, reducing the need for multiple app downloads and logins.

 
 
• 
 
The idea was **envisioned by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar** during the **March Conference of Chief Electoral Officers**.

 
 
• 
 
ECINET will be accessible via **desktop and smartphone**.

 
 
• 
 
**Only authorized EC officials** will enter data to ensure **accuracy and integrity**.
